divisionMapping.conclusion: The mapping is defensible as an explicit partitive substructure, not an exact match to the basic equal-sharing item.
divisionMapping.basis: After deriving the total overlap length W and fixed number of equal overlap groups g=n−1, the unknown is the size W/g of one overlap. Group count is known and group size is unknown, matching the information direction of partitive division.
requiredDifferences: The whole is derived using multiplication and subtraction rather than supplied directly.
The group count is inferred as n−1adjacent joins rather than supplied as a fixed number of people.
The candidate partitions continuous length in centimeters rather than discrete marbles.
The source distribution/remainder microsteps are not all tested merely because the final division is exact.

HD32-d1-T01-A05:record the size of one join with cm units
HD32-d1-T01-A08:write the equal-partition division with quotient units
HD32-d1-T01-A09:check join count times one-overlap length equals total overlap

rejectedAlternative.reason: The candidate forms its dividend by gross-length multiplication and subtraction, not by combining two independently supplied wholes. Labeling it add-then-divide would misstate the solution structure.

multiplicationMapping.conclusion: The mapping is defensible as gross repeated whole minus one aggregate deduction, with a material additional n−1count/product step.
multiplicationMapping.basis: Compute the repeated raw whole L×n, construct aggregate overlap o×(n−1), and remove that aggregate once from the whole. This preserves product-then-subtraction scope but extends the source basic12×8−17 and design24×6−17.
requiredDifferences: The source gives a single aggregate removal amount17directly; the candidate derives the aggregate removal from overlap length and n−1joins.
The candidate has two products and a join-count deduction, rather than only one product followed by subtraction.
Subtracting an overlap for every tape would remove one extra overlap; n−1is essential.
supportedResearchActions: HM32-d3-T01-A01:label raw strip length and number of strips separately
HM32-d3-T01-A02:interpret one aggregate loss from the completed raw whole
HM32-d3-T01-A06:restore the removed aggregate to check the raw whole

issues.message: Both core axes should remain partial and explicitly retain the extra preparatory product/subtraction or join-count reasoning; do not present the research basic item and overlap task as identical.
The number of adjacent joins is one fewer than the number of pieces. Each manual solution and recommendation must preserve that count.

claim: The preserved analysis concerns the cited examples and mappings; it is not a new mathematical audit of all57 candidates.
